description:
Change an agent. Only the fields you send are changed; omit the rest. Sending voice replaces the whole voice object.

Requires scope `agents:write`.

appointment_booking_enabled.description: Let the agent book appointments during a call.

knowledge_base_id.description: A knowledge base the agent can draw on. See list_knowledge_bases.

language.description: BCP-47 tag for the conversation, e.g. "en-US" or "hi-IN".

mcp_server_ids.description: MCP servers (connected apps) whose enabled tools the agent can use during calls. See list_mcp_servers. Replaces the list; [] removes all.

name.description: A label for your own reference, e.g. "Support line".

opening_message.description: Spoken as soon as the call connects. Supports {{name}} style merge fields from the lead. Required: an agent without one answers in silence.

outbound_phone_number_id.description: Default caller id for outbound calls placed with this agent. See list_phone_numbers.

system_prompt.description: The agent's instructions. This is a spoken conversation, so keep it short, concrete, and free of markdown.

tool_ids.description: Your own tools (webhook and client) the agent can use during calls. See list_tools. Replaces the list; [] removes all.

voice.description: Either a COMPOSED pipeline {stt, llm, tts} (all three required together) or a single REALTIME model {realtime}. Never both, with one exception: an openai/ realtime model (GPT-Live) may carry {llm} too, naming the OpenRouter model that answers behind its voice. Use list_engines to pick models that are available right now.

max_tokens.description: Caps reply length. Long replies cost the caller waiting time as well as money.

model.description: "provider/model", e.g. "deepgram/nova-3" or "openrouter/anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5". Call list_engines for what is available and priced.

endpointing_ms.description: Silence before a turn is considered finished. Lower is snappier and more prone to cutting people off.

language.description: BCP-47 tag, or "multi" for automatic detection. Default en-US.

model.description: "provider/model", e.g. "deepgram/nova-3" or "openrouter/anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5". Call list_engines for what is available and priced.
"provider/model", e.g. "deepgram/nova-3" or "openrouter/anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5". Call list_engines for what is available and priced.

voice.description: Provider voice id, e.g. an ElevenLabs voice id, or a cloned voice's provider_voice_id from list_voices.

interrupt_sensitivity.description: How readily the agent stops talking when the caller speaks. Default normal.

whatsapp.description: WhatsApp: the number it sends from on calls, and its WhatsApp tools (all off until turned on). Fields you leave out keep their value.

account_id.description: The WhatsApp number the agent sends from during phone calls. See list_whatsapp_accounts.

allowed_templates.description: Other template names the agent may send by its own choice.

auto_booking_confirmation.description: Send booking_confirmation as soon as the agent books an appointment.

auto_reminder_minutes.description: Send reminder this many minutes before each appointment the agent books. 0 is off.

chat_model.description: OpenRouter text model for WhatsApp chats, e.g. "openrouter/openai/gpt-6-luna".

templates.description: The approved template used for each purpose. See list_whatsapp_templates.

interactive.description: Offer reply buttons and lists in a WhatsApp chat.

media.description: Send knowledge-base files whose original was kept.

messages.description: Send the caller free text on WhatsApp, inside their 24-hour window.

schedule.description: Schedule a reminder or follow-up template.

templates.description: Send approved templates from allowed_templates and the purpose templates.

name: update_agent
title: Update an agent
